rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for incising, dividing something with a sharp tool, or shaping it by cutting; gem-cutting may be phrased more technically.

example.english: I cut the apple open with a knife.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 baa2 dou1 cit3 hoi1 go3 ping4 gwo2

rows.note: For an actual cut or incision in the body, this is the all-purpose noun.

example.english: I have a cut on my hand.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 jau5 tiu4 soeng1 hau2

rows.note: Use this for a cut in pay, rather than for a general deletion.

example.english: The company plans to cut salaries this year.
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 jiu3 gaam2 san1

rows.note: Use this for the haircut as an activity or service.

example.english: I'm going to cut my hair tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 jat6 heoi3 zin2 faat3

rows.note: Use this when intentionally reducing an amount such as salaries, spending, or prices.

example.english: The company decided to cut wages.
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 gaam2 jan4 gung1

rows.note: Use this for stopping or ceasing an activity, process, or action.

example.jyutping: maa4 faan4 nei5 ting4 zi2 bo3 go1

rows.note: Use this for a share of profits or revenue that someone takes.

example.english: The platform takes a cut from every order.
example.jyutping: ping4 toi4 mui5 zoeng1 daan1 dou1 wui5 cau1 sing4

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone enters a queue ahead of people who were already waiting.

example.english: Don’t cut in; everyone has been queuing for ages.
example.traditional: 你唔好打尖，大家排隊排咗好耐㗎喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 daa2 zim1 daai6 gaa1 paai4 deoi6 paai4 zo2 hou2 noi6 gaa3 laa3
